page.layout: One page of text, single column; a decorative band and chapter heading below the text; a closing summary line at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: lendum necessariarū: tum etiā terrenarum rerū velut natura proprietatisq; rerum omnium in hoc visibili mū-do creatarū. 2. Habebat cordis seu voluntatis humane puritatē & rectitudinem. 3. Corporis copositiqué ipsius totius summā pulchritudinē, ac immortalitatē. 4. Dignitatem ac dominatum in omnia hæc visibilia à Deo condita. Erat igitur vterq; homo mente perspi-cax, corde purus, corpore immortalis, dignitate domi-nus. Omnia enim Homini Deus subiecerat: Hominem sibi duntaxat: vt esset Homo quidē totius huius Mun-di Dominus vtilis, qui vocatur: Deus autem ipse eius-dem Mundi Dominus directus. Denique Deus ad se colendum dederat Homini & Legem, & sacramenta duo, nempe duas illas, quas diximus, Arbores: Legem autem hanc, nimirum vt sua sorte contentus Homo ea-rum arborum altera abstineret, Gen. 1. 27. 29. & 2. 17. & 3. 3. & 5. 3. Quaue donis & Spiritualibus, & corporeis (quantum eius felicitas in his terris postula-bat) praditus erat Homo vterque à Deo, quibus ys-dem donis posteri quoque eorum postea donandi omnes erant, & haredes futuri.
main_text.head: CAPVT II.

p.i: Disputata, & agitata quedam in his singulis capitibus octo.

page.notes: Page is a text page with a decorative ornament band above the chapter heading. The final line "Multa" is set in italic at the right; treated as a closing line. Several words are underlined in the printed original and some ligatures and abbreviations are uncertain, notably "Quaue" and "sorte". Printed "Quaue" may be an error for "Quæ ue"; left as printed.
